known_constraints: ArchUnit rule: no System.out or printStackTrace anywhere in backend code (spec.md S12)
ArchUnit rule: only com.assessment.auth.audit may write to the audit logger (spec.md S12)
ArchUnit rule: no @Async and no @Scheduled anywhere in backend code (spec.md S12)
ArchUnit rule: no manual HTTP clients (spec.md S12)
Every integration test re-runs on Testcontainers PostgreSQL at mvn verify; Docker must be available to the build (spec.md S12)
Security-critical tests use full-HTTP TestRestTemplate, not MockMvc, so Set-Cookie attributes, the CSRF round-trip and getRemoteAddr() are real (spec.md S12)
Backend is pinned to Java 21, Spring Boot 4.0.x, Spring Security 7.0.x, Maven with a committed wrapper (spec.md S1)
Frontend is pinned to Vite, React 19, TypeScript, react-router v7 and axios (axios specifically, for the global 401/403 interceptor) (spec.md S1)
One repo with sibling backend/ and frontend/; feature-first packages under com.assessment.auth, audit/ the single logging owner (spec.md S1)
Secrets come from environment variables with no committed defaults; a missing APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD fails startup (spec.md S1)
First boot is three steps: log in, change password, log in again; a password change invalidates all sessions including the caller's (spec.md S9)
Unverified assumption to test first: a Secure session cookie round-trips over http://localhost; secure: true is set in every profile (spec.md S13)
